thread:
Maya: quick heads-up — proposing a small allocator toggle on dedicated-gpu-pool-3 tonight at 21:30 UTC. target window ~30m to measure burst-tail latency and eviction behavior.
Ryan: ok — who will own the flip and the monitoring? any CI gating?
Aless: i'll own the flip + first 15m of monitoring. no CI gating, it's a config flip only. i'll run a dry-run first.
Jess: oncall assign? Tina, can you watch SLOs/traces during the window?
Tina: i'm oncall and can watch p50/p95/p99 dashboards, pod OOMs, and autoscaler logs. ping this thread when you flip.
Maya: smoke checklist (quick):
- send canary traffic to pool-3 at 5 rps for 5m
- p95 latency < 350ms for canary
- no pod OOMs in pool-3
- autoscaler maintains >= min_replicas and no rapid churn
- KV cache hit-rate remains within expected range
Aless: plan:
1) dry-run allocator decisions
2) flip at 21:30 UTC
3) route 5rps canary -> pool-3 for 5m
4) observe 15m, if green ramp to normal
5) rollback on regressions
Dry-run command:
```bash
./infractl allocator preview --pool=pool-3 --mode=spread-aware --out=preview.json
```
Flip command:
```bash
./infractl allocator apply --pool=pool-3 --mode=spread-aware --reason="burst-tail test"
```
Rollback command:
```bash
./infractl allocator apply --pool=pool-3 --mode=fit-first --reason="rollback - regressions"
```
Jess: i'm drafting a 1-paragraph runbook and rollback checklist. also creating an alert: p95 > 400ms and pod OOM events.
Ryan: timeline + ownership: Aless flips at 21:30 UTC, Tina monitors, Jess on alerts/runbook, Maya coordinates canary routing. stop on any single "stop" from monitor or owner.
Aless: i'll post live updates: "dry-run complete", "flipping now", "observations: ...". holding 5m after flip before ramp.
Maya: pre-checks: confirm pool-3 node headroom >=20% and autoscaler min_replicas >=2. Aless?
Aless: confirmed headroom 28%, min_replicas=2. dry-run output ok, no OOM suggestions.
Tina: watching dashboards. i'll call stop if p95 > 400ms or any OOMs.
deploy-bot: scheduled action by Aless at 1768505400 (planned). :robot_face:
Jess: runbook rollback steps:
- run rollback command (Aless)
- revert canary routing to previous pool mapping (Maya)
- escalate to eng-runtime + eng-sre if >2 failures in 10m
- collect logs: /var/log/allocator/*.log and autoscaler events
- open post-check thread in #eng-releases
Aless: i'll be on zoom for the flip and will update this thread with timestamps.
Ryan: thanks team — ping here when you start. :thumbsup:
Maya: acknowledged. see you at 21:30 UTC. :eyes:
